import rclpy,json,time,datetime
from rclpy.parameter import Parameter
from rclpy.qos import QoSProfile,QoSDurabilityPolicy,QoSReliabilityPolicy
from geometry_msgs.msg import PoseStamped,PoseWithCovarianceStamped
from nav_msgs.msg import Odometry
from tf2_msgs.msg import TFMessage
rclpy.init();node=rclpy.create_node('observacion_tiempos_lectura');node.set_parameters([Parameter('use_sim_time',value=True)]);rows={k:[] for k in ['amcl','truth','odom','tf','tf_static']}
def pose(kind,msg):
 if len(rows[kind])>=800:return
 p=msg.pose.pose if kind in ('amcl','odom') else msg.pose;q=p.orientation
 rows[kind].append({'header_stamp_ns':msg.header.stamp.sec*10**9+msg.header.stamp.nanosec,'received_ros_ns':node.get_clock().now().nanoseconds,'received_monotonic_s':time.monotonic(),'frame':msg.header.frame_id,'xyz':[p.position.x,p.position.y,p.position.z],'quaternion':[q.x,q.y,q.z,q.w]})
def tf(kind,msg):
 if len(rows[kind])>=1200:return
 rows[kind].append({'received_ros_ns':node.get_clock().now().nanoseconds,'transforms':[{'parent':t.header.frame_id,'child':t.child_frame_id,'stamp_ns':t.header.stamp.sec*10**9+t.header.stamp.nanosec,'xyz':[t.transform.translation.x,t.transform.translation.y,t.transform.translation.z],'quaternion':[t.transform.rotation.x,t.transform.rotation.y,t.transform.rotation.z,t.transform.rotation.w]} for t in msg.transforms]})
subs=[]
for kind,typ,topic in [('amcl',PoseWithCovarianceStamped,'/amcl_pose'),('truth',PoseStamped,'/ground_truth/pose'),('odom',Odometry,'/odom')]:subs.append(node.create_subscription(typ,topic,lambda msg,kind=kind:pose(kind,msg),10))
subs.append(node.create_subscription(TFMessage,'/tf',lambda msg:tf('tf',msg),100));subs.append(node.create_subscription(TFMessage,'/tf_static',lambda msg:tf('tf_static',msg),QoSProfile(depth=1,durability=QoSDurabilityPolicy.TRANSIENT_LOCAL,reliability=QoSReliabilityPolicy.RELIABLE)))
start=time.monotonic()
while time.monotonic()-start<12:rclpy.spin_once(node,timeout_sec=.05)
print('LIVE_TF_WINDOW '+json.dumps({'scope':'12wall seconds passive original AMCL/truth/odom/TF messages while unchanged native runs. No services, actions, motion publications or changed parameters. Not an additional acceptance run.','utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'rows':rows}),flush=True)
node.destroy_node();rclpy.shutdown()
